name: Roast suckling pig
summary: VOV names lợn sữa quay at the end of the Pac Ngoi list. VnExpress, in 2014, names lợn sữa among the foods at a stay in the village. A weight, a wood, and a price were not printed.
origin: Pac Ngoi. VOV on the rural desk. VnExpress, 28 November 2014, names it in the same stay as hill chicken and upland rice.
howToEat: Eat it at the house when the meal has been booked. VOV does not call it a breakfast. A carving note was not printed.
A price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
